'''Spacecap Droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used to handle baggage. Multiple were employed at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency's [[Tomorrowland Starport]], where they were tasked with loading checked luggage onto the hangar's baggage conveyor.<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> [[F-25-OJSx]],<ref name="Star Tours">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> an [[F series repair droid]],<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> worked as a Spacecap Droid at Tomorrowland Starport.<ref name="Star Tours" />
